results: Requirement F20 fully implemented and verified: Direct origin, forged header, revoked session, expired bundle and policy outage all fail as specified.

EvaluateEnforcementFixture implemented in internal/gateway/enforcement.go orchestrating durable trust key/bundle activation, session/revocation stores, upstream proxy evaluation, and policy bundle evaluation.
Direct origin access without gateway proof is rejected with 403 DIRECT_ORIGIN_BYPASS_DENIED.
Forged identity/privilege headers (X-PolicyHelix-Roles) are rejected with 403 FORGED_HEADER_REJECTED.
Revoked sessions are rejected within the 30-second revocation window with 403 REVOKED_SESSION_DENIED.
Expired policy bundles are rejected with 403 EXPIRED_POLICY_BUNDLE and fail closed when no active valid bundle is in force.
Policy engine outage fails closed with 503 DECISION_LOSS_SENSITIVE_DENY on private routes while allowing intentional public bypass on /health (INTENTIONAL_PUBLIC_BYPASS).

One modified byte (TAMPERED_BUNDLE_DIGEST), missing signature/untrusted signer (UNTRUSTED_OR_MISSING_SIGNER), and stale/replayed revisions (STALE_OR_REPLAYED_REVISION) fail and preserve the last valid accepted bundle authority across restart.
Engine CLI flag -verify-enforcement and HTTP endpoint POST /api/v1/gateway/enforcement/verify registered in cmd/policyhelix/main.go and proxied through scripts/serve-web.mjs.
Eleven Apache-2.0 synthetic fixtures cataloged with SHA-256 digests in tests/fixtures/policyhelix/C26/manifest.json and documented in docs/evidence/enforcement-template.md.
